description: Arizona (United States) Data Center Data Set is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Wageningen University & Research, University of Oxford. This dataset provides a listing of data centers in Arizona, focusing on hyperscale facilities, large colocation providers, and small colocation facilities with an emphasis on AI-focused infrastructure. Coverage: national (US); the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support communication-network and digital-infrastructure studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
